# Summary

The survey covered *twelve* sites over **six weeks**, with `three` crews working in parallel.[^1]
Results are summarised below; see [the method notes](#method) and the
[public guidance](https://example.org/guidance) for details.

[^1]: Two crews joined in the second week.

## Findings

1. Water levels were within the expected range.
   - Site A: slightly high.
   - Site B: normal.
2. Access roads need repair at three sites.[^2]
3. All equipment was returned.

[^2]: Repairs are scheduled for the spring.

| Site | Visits | Samples | Status |
|:-----|-------:|--------:|:------:|
| A    | 4      | 36      | Done   |
| B    | 3      | 27      | Done   |
| C    | 5      | 41      | Open   |

: Visits and samples per site

![Samples per week](chart.png){width=6cm}

> Measurements taken after heavy rain were repeated the following day.

## Method {#method}

Each crew followed the checklist:

```
check gauge
record level
photograph site
```
